strings.step_aside_pickup: Magpie pickup is off: {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_merge: Magpie ground stacks are off: {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_float: Magpie floating items are off: {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_loot: Magpie loot multiplier is off: {0} is installed.
strings.import_done: Imported {0} Magpie settings. Source files were retained.
strings.import_sync_incomplete: Magpie import was saved locally, but synchronization did not complete. Review synchronization; do not retry this preview.
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Turns all of Magpie on or off. Off: the game's own auto pickup runs and no item is merged, floated or marked.
strings.cfg_1_general__pickup_enabled_help: Magpie pickup (fast, smooth magnet). Off: the game's own auto pickup runs.
strings.cfg_1_general__merge_enabled_help: Identical items lying near each other merge into one stack.
strings.cfg_1_general__float_enabled_help: Dropped items float on water and tar like wood. A change also applies to items already lying in the world.
strings.cfg_2_pickup__auto_pickup_at_start_help: Auto pickup state when the game starts; the game's auto pickup key (and the optional toggle key) changes it in play.
strings.cfg_2_pickup__pickup_range_help: Radius in meters around the player in which items glide in. The server's Max Pickup Range caps it; range bonuses from other mods still scale it.
strings.cfg_2_pickup__magnet_speed_help: Speed in meters per second at which items glide to the player (the game uses 15).
strings.cfg_2_pickup__scan_interval_help: Seconds between searches for items in range.
strings.cfg_2_pickup__max_pickups_per_scan_help: Items taken per search at most; 0 means no limit. Never more than one item per frame.
strings.cfg_2_pickup__ignore_items_help: Comma-separated prefab names that are never picked up automatically (picking them up by hand still works).
strings.cfg_2_pickup__max_pickup_range_help: Largest Pickup Range any player may use, in meters.
strings.cfg_3_messages__show_pickup_messages_hel: Shows the top-left message for each item taken automatically.
strings.cfg_3_messages__group_pickup_messages_he: Items of the same kind taken within one second show as one line with the summed amount.
strings.cfg_3_messages__skip_pickup_effects_help: No particles or sound for each item taken automatically.
strings.cfg_4_merge__merge_radius_help: Distance in meters within which identical items merge.
strings.cfg_4_merge__merge_min_count_help: Identical items needed within the radius before they merge.
strings.cfg_4_merge__max_merges_per_scan_help: Merges started per scan at most.
strings.cfg_4_merge__merge_settle_time_help: Seconds an item must lie still before it may merge.
strings.cfg_4_merge__merge_ignore_items_help: Comma-separated prefab names that never merge.
strings.cfg_5_float__excluded_items_help: Comma-separated prefab names that keep sinking, for example "Coins, IronScrap". A change also applies to items already lying in the world.
strings.cfg_6_cheats__loot_multiplier_help: Cheat: world loot you pick up is multiplied by this number (1 = off). Only drops from creatures, destructibles, rocks, trees, pickables and loot spawners; the extras are not marked as cheated. In multiplayer the server decides.
strings.cfg_6_cheats__loot_sources_help: Cheat: which kinds of world loot the multiplier applies to. Player drops, chest and tombstone spills, refunds and station output never count.
strings.cfg_6_cheats__stackable_only_help: Cheat: only stackable loot is multiplied; weapons, armor and other single items stay one item.
strings.cfg_7_interface__pickup_toggle_key_help: Optional key that turns auto pickup on or off, like the game's own auto pickup key. Merging and the loot multiplier are not affected.
strings.cfg_7_interface__pickup_toggle_pad_chord: Optional gamepad chord that toggles auto pickup, for example LB+X. Unbound by default; typing and game windows block it. Merging and loot are unaffected.
strings.cfg_7_interface__locked_player_settings_: Comma-separated Magpie Local setting IDs (Section.Key) that the server forces to its own values. Empty: personal settings remain independent.
